## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes (this also verifies the tool registry).
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes.
- [ ] The tool works in light **and** dark themes.
- [ ] The tool works on a narrow (320 px) viewport.
- [ ] The description and keywords in `src/lib/catalog.ts` are accurate.
- [ ] `version` was bumped if existing behaviour changed.
- [ ] No user data leaves the browser.
